messages:
julia_csm: Daily digest — OrchidHealth renewal/adoption.
What I did: called AE, escalated webhook retries, opened ticket INC-4527.
Blockers: OrchidHealth is seeing 500s on callbacks; staging->prod webhook failures persist.
Today: need eng to triage logs, consider canary rollback to previous router kernel, and confirm SLA impact.
Link to ticket: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INC-4527

maria_cs: Adding the last 2 error samples from customer — they include request_id 8786-orchid and "kv_cache miss" in stack.

aj_dev: Looking now. Can you paste full request_id and which model they're pinned to? @simon_eng fyi, could be routing or kernel selection.

julia_csm: request_id: 8786-orchid-2026-03-17-21
Model pinned: redwood/efficax-13b-quant-v2
Snippet from customer:
```
HTTP/1.1 500 Internal Server Error
X-Request-Id: 8786-orchid-2026-03-17-21
Error: kv_cache.get failed: key not found
```

simon_eng: Oncall check — I'm seeing elevated 503s out of region-eu-2 around 21:02 UTC, autoscaler flapping and kernel 3.0 selection recent deploy. Suggest temporary routing to dedicated pool for OrchidHealth while we triage. @leo_support can you open a short burst?

leo_support: Opened internal ticket BLAST-2026 to add burst capacity and route OrchidHealth to dedicated pool for 30m. Notified infra. :thumbsup:

aj_dev: Quick repro I ran locally:
```
curl -H 'X-Request-Id: 8786-orchid-2026-03-17-21' \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer xxxxx' \
  -d '{"input":"test"}' \
  https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate
```
Got 500 with same kv_cache stacktrace.

simon_eng: That matches the KV cache regression from last kernel selector change. Plan: start canary rollback to kernel 2.1 (safe path) at 21:15 UTC, target 5% traffic. If errors drop, ramp and then full rollback. I'll kick it off now unless you want to notify customer first.

julia_csm: Customer prefers immediate mitigation. Please proceed with canary rollback and ping me when canary is stable so I can update the renewal call notes (3pm PT). I'll also update INC-4527 and CC the AE.

incident_bot: Deploy rollback started by simon_eng — deployment id dpl-8892 — canary target 5% traffic. https://deploys.redwood.ai/dpl-8892

aj_dev: Watching traces — errors dropping from ~12% -> 1.8% in the last 2 minutes. Logs show kv_cache.get success on canary.

julia_csm: Thanks team. I'll prep a short note for the customer and include mitigation steps and timeline. Anything else to surface for renewal call?

simon_eng: I'll draft a short postmortem and mitigation doc tomorrow, will link to INC-4527. Flag: kv cache regression introduced by kernel selector change, will include recommended tests to prevent regression. :white_check_mark:

maria_cs: adding that AE asked for confirmation on whether usage data prior to the incident will be included in billing — I'll follow up with finance separately.

julia_csm: great, closing this digest for now. Please ping in thread with any updates and I'll relay to customer. :raised_hands:
